ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Figure 5 on the right is a schematic diagram of land-use changes in a certain city. <image1> According to the diagram, the ____ of transportation lines will affect the evolution of the urban spatial form.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In Figure 5, multiple transportation lines or transportation-condition labels can be seen, including the "canal" in the upper left, the "Yangtze River" in the upper right, and the "railway" on the right. The legend shows that urban land is divided by time into "land before 1950," "land after 1960," and "land after 1990"; the land-use area gradually expands from smaller patches, and the direction of expansion is related to the positions and trends of these transportation lines. Then reason: The question stem asks, "the ____ of transportation lines will affect the evolution of the urban spatial form." Combining the diagram and geographic laws, the development of transportation lines will guide the city to expand along transportation trunk lines; at the same time, if a certain transportation line loses its original transportation advantage and declines, it will also change the direction of urban development and spatial form. Therefore "decline" should be filled in.

raw_record.question_text:
Figure 5 on the right is a schematic diagram of land-use changes in a certain city.

<image1>

According to the diagram, the ____ of transportation lines will affect the evolution of the urban spatial form.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中标出多条交通线或交通条件，包括“运河”“长江”“铁路”，并用图例表示1950年前用地、1960年后用地、1990年后用地。城市用地范围随时间扩大，且形态明显受这些交通线走向和位置影响。再读题：题干问“交通线的____会影响城市空间形态的演变”。结合地理规律，交通线不仅发展会引导城市扩展，交通线一旦失去原有运输优势、发生衰落，也会改变城市发展方向和空间形态。因此填“衰落”。
